quick-preview.label: Quick preview
quick-preview.description: Coarse run intended to validate event, time window and approximate domain before spending time on a detailed simulation.

balanced-local.label: Balanced local run
balanced-local.description: Default local run class for a single-domain historical event replay on a workstation or GitHub-hosted test-sized setup.

detailed-local.label: Detailed local run
detailed-local.description: Smaller, higher-resolution experiment that should only be selected after a coarse preview has validated the setup.

expensive-high-resolution.label: Expensive high-resolution run
expensive-high-resolution.description: Placeholder for future very high-resolution domains. The UI should warn users before selecting this class.
